exposure: Women who delivered babies in the last 12 months
Place of delivery (Block level Primary Health Center (PHC), medical college, private facility)
Awareness of Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
cohort: 210 women residing in a rural community in Bankura, West Bengal, India who delivered babies in the last 12 months
finding: Gaps exist in the awareness of beneficiaries regarding entitlement under JSSK, and drugs and transport are major causes of out-of-pocket expenditure in public health facilities.
